title: Senate PRIB sorry for 'flame transition effect' during Cayetano's prayer
summary: The Senate's Public Relations and Information Bureau (PRIB) on Thursday apologized after a special effects of a flame suddenly appeared while Senate Minority Leader Cayetano was leading the opening…

blocks.text: The Senate's Public Relations and Information Bureau (PRIB) on Thursday apologized after a special effects of a flame suddenly appeared while Senate Minority Leader Cayetano was leading the opening prayer on Day 44 of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial.

"We sincerely apologize for the accidental transition effect that appeared during the livestream of the Senate Impeachment Court proceedings today. The incident was due to an unexpected technical issue during the broadcast, which we deeply regret," the statement read.

The PRIB added that it's "currently upgrading its equipment and undergoing retraining and upskilling of its technical staff in a bid to strengthen the quality of broadcast media coverage for the Filipino people."
After the technical glitch caught the attention of netizens, Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis "Chiz" Escudero ordered to edit out the flames in the video.

"I would like to instruct the clerk of court to kindly instruct the PRIB to be mindful or careful, with respect to the transition effects. The flames are not well taken and inappropriate to these proceedings...Remove and edit it out from the records of the impeachment court," he said. —VAL, GMA News
